hint: Words are matched as typed, with no stemming. A term of 3 or more characters matches the start of a word (“awari” finds “awaria”); a shorter one must match exactly. Every term must appear within one message or within the title. Case and accents are ignored.

error.tooShort: Type at least two characters, with a letter or a digit.
error.invalid: The search cannot contain control characters.
error.timeout: The search took too long. Narrow it down with a more specific word.
error.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.rate: Too many searches. Wait a moment and try again.
error.gone: This room no longer exists, or you are no longer a member of it.
